form.note: Empty: the request page writes the request as an email in the visitor's own mail program. Set it to the address of a form service that accepts a JSON POST from https://bccs.bio and answers {"ok":true}; the page then sends directly and keeps the email route as the fallback.

analytics.note: provider: none | cloudflare (token = the site token of Cloudflare Web Analytics) | plausible (token = the domain registered with Plausible) | goatcounter (token = the full count address, e.g. https://stats.example.org/count). The privacy page follows this setting.

verification.note: The content of the verification meta tags that Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools give out. Empty: no tag is written.
